maintenance_led.reason: Sells ammonia, nitric acid and UAN fertilizer, consumed in use or as feedstock, not parts or services for installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are farmers, chemical makers and mining firms paying privately; DoD contractor sales are only a small niche.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by running its own plants in Arkansas, Alabama and Oklahoma, plus operating a Covestro facility, not by roll-up acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Fertilizer and ammonia are largely commodity chemicals bought on price and logistics, so buyers can switch suppliers fairly easily.

notes: Fertilizer likely outweighs industrial and mining sales; some high-purity industrial grades may be harder to switch.
